item.title: Spartans swept in soccer by Pleasant Valley
item.description: The Red Bluff varsity girls soccer team lost to visiting Pleasant Valley on Wednesday night, 4-1. With the loss, the Spartans fell to 12-3-4 overall and 1-1-3 in Eastern Athletic League play, while PV improved to 5-0 in league play and 5-4-1 overall.

item.title: Owner of Johnny Rockets, Fatburger files for bankruptcy
item.description: FAT Brands — the owner of multiple restaurant chains including Johnny Rockets, Fatburger and Twin Peaks — has filed for bankruptcy amid debt of more than $1 billion.

item.title: Nationwide economic shutdown set for Friday in protest of ICE policies
item.description: Hundreds of organizations across the U.S. are calling for a day of no work, no school and no shopping in a national shutdown in protest against ICE policies.

item.title: Former First Brands CEO Patrick James and his brother are indicted for bilking billions from banks
item.description: The indictment said the brothers duped investors and banks with fake documents and false reports.

item.title: Trump threatens Canada with 50% tariff on aircraft sold in US, expanding trade war
item.description: It's the latest salvo in his trade war with Canada and Prime Minister Mark Carney.

item.title: Trump threatens tariffs on any country selling oil to Cuba, a move that puts pressure on Mexico
item.description: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said her government had temporarily stopped oil shipments to Cuba.

item.title: Jury finds Wisconsin man guilty of forging threat against Trump to get witness deported
item.description: The jury found Demetric Scott guilty of identity theft and witness intimidation.
